name: TPS54560B
description: TI TPS54560B 4.5-60 V input, 5 A step-down DC/DC converter with Eco-mode, peak-current-mode control, 100 kHz-2.5 MHz fixed frequency (RT/CLK), internal soft-start, cycle-by-cycle current limit, adjustable UVLO, 0.8 V reference, 8-pin HSOIC PowerPAD (DDA). Motor/solenoid rail buck (6-7 V from the 6S branch, 22.2-25.2 V) of builds/6s/10A/BRUSHED_CAN_485_isolation/.
verification: VERIFIED -- full 8-pin map read directly from the local copy of [65] (TI SLVSF00, January 2019), Sec. 5 'Pin Configuration and Functions', 'DDA Package 8-Pin HSOIC With PowerPAD' figure and the Pin Functions table. Pin electrical types follow the table's I/O column: BOOT -> passive (bootstrap capacitor node, listed O); VIN -> power_in; EN -> input ('internal pullup current source', float to enable); RT/CLK -> input; FB -> input; COMP -> passive (error-amplifier output with compensation network, listed O); GND -> power_in; SW -> passive (switch node, listed I). Device facts also VERIFIED from [65]: Sec. 6.3 operating input voltage 4.5-60 V, IO 0-5 A; Sec. 6.5 current-limit test 6.3/7.9/9.5 A; Sec. 7.3.8 internal soft start; Sec. 7.3.10 current limit. FOOTPRINT: TI DDA0008B land pattern from the same datasheet's EXAMPLE BOARD LAYOUT sheet, generated by symbols/tools/gen_ti_powerpad_footprints.py. The exposed pad is NOT a symbol pin (repo convention); [65] Sec. 5 requires it to be electrically connected to GND on the board -- do that with copper at layout. The external inductor, catch diode and compensation parts are NOT selected by this spec.
